title: ikuku layered-delivery manifest
description: Describes the ordered stack of layers that assemble a prospect-specific ERPNext distro. Supports Strategy A (fat vhdx base + file overlays) and Strategy B (standard-Ubuntu base + podman image/volume layers). See docs/LAYERS.md and docs/STRATEGY-B-results.md.

strategy.description: A = fat vhdx base imported + file overlays. B = standard Ubuntu base (wsl --install) + podman image/volume layers. Defaults to A when absent (schemaVersion 1).

distro.description: WSL distro name the base imports/installs as. 'ikuku' for A; for B the base is a standard Ubuntu distro (often named 'Ubuntu' or reused).

id.description: Unique layer id within the manifest.

order.description: Ascending apply order. Higher layers may overwrite/extend lower ones.

role.description: Layer role; drives caching policy and reseller swappability. base: the OS. app: ERPNext container images. kiro: the kiro-cli binaries. vertical: industry data (volumes/seed). prospect: name/OTP/niche.

artifact.description: Artifact filename relative to the kit / cache root. Omitted when applyMode is 'wsl-install' (the base is pulled by wsl --install, not shipped).

sha256.description: Content digest of the artifact. Used for cache hits + integrity. Omitted for 'wsl-install'.

cache.description: machine: cache under C:\ikuku\cache, reuse across all kits (base image + kiro). industry: reuse across prospects of same vertical. none: never cached, always ships.

applyMode.description: import (A): layer IS the rootfs (wsl --import; --vhd for .vhdx), order 0. wsl-install (B): base pulled by `wsl --install -d <distro>`, no artifact. podman-load (B): artifact is a `podman save` image tar -> `podman load`. volume-import (B): artifact is a `podman volume export` tar -> create+import as a named volume. overlay (A/B): tar extracted over the distro root by the composer.

volumeName.description: For applyMode 'volume-import': the podman named volume to create+import into (e.g. 'ikuku_frappe-bench').

wslDistro.description: For applyMode 'wsl-install': the distro to install (default 'Ubuntu').

description.description: Human-readable summary of the layer's contents.
